label: Level 1
title: A menu on every table.
body: Guests scan the code and the menu opens in their browser. Photos, prices and categories, always up to date.

label: Level 2
title: One button calls the waiter.
body: Guests fill the cart, then tap the button below it. The waiter is notified with the table number and comes over to take the order.

label: Level 3
title: The order goes straight in.
body: Guests place the order themselves. It reaches reception or the kitchen, gets prepared and is served. They can follow its status.
